import runpy

parse_enabled = runpy.run_path('parser.py')['parse_enabled']
cases = [('true', True), ('false', False), ('TRUE', ValueError), (' false ', ValueError), ('', ValueError), ('garbage', ValueError), (None, ValueError), (True, ValueError), (1, ValueError)]
for value, expected in cases:
    try:
        actual = parse_enabled(value)
    except Exception as exc:
        actual = type(exc)
    passed = actual is expected
    expected_label = expected.__name__ if isinstance(expected, type) else repr(expected)
    actual_label = actual.__name__ if isinstance(actual, type) else repr(actual)
    print(f'{\"PASS\" if passed else \"FAIL\"}: input={value"'!r}, expected={expected_label}, actual={actual_label}'"')
